purpose.zh: 练侧腹和臀部外侧，适合入门的侧撑
purpose.en: Build the sides of your waist and outer hips with a beginner side plank.

text.zh: 前臂和膝盖撑地，屁股抬起成一条直线
text.en: Prop on your forearm and knee and lift your hips into a straight line

text.zh: 手肘在肩膀正下方，用力推地。
text.en: Keep your elbow under your shoulder and push the floor away.

text.zh: 正常呼吸，屁股别往下掉。
text.en: Breathe normally and do not let your hips drop.

commonErrors.en: Letting the shoulder sink toward the ear.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼时，幅度小一点或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, move less far or switch to an easier version.

changes: 动画全程静止保持 → kind hold（App 计时），剂量 mode hold 改 time、每侧 20 秒
名字「短杠杆」是术语，改「屈膝侧平板 / Bent-Knee Side Plank」
